prompt: In some areas, libraries, parks and community centres that were once run by paid council staff are now managed by local volunteers. Some people believe this is the best way to keep such services open, while others argue that local government should pay professionals to run them. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Nowadays, many local governments do not have enough money, so some libraries, parks and community centres are run by the volunteers instead of the paid workers. Some people think this is a good way to keep these places open, but other people think the government should pay professional staff to run them. I will discuss both views and give my opinion.

On the one hand, there are some reasons why volunteers are a good solution. Firstly, if there is no money, it is better to have the library open with volunteers than to close it. Secondly, the volunteers are usually living in the same area, so they know what the local people need and they care about the place. For example, a retired teacher can help the children with their homework in the library. In addition, volunteering is good for the volunteers themself, because they can meet new people and feel useful.

On the other hand, many people believe that the government has the responsibility to run these services. The professional staff have the training and the experience, for example a librarian knows how to organise the books and how to help people to find the information. The volunteers can stop coming at any time, so the service is not reliable. Also, it is not fair that the people work for free while they pay taxes for these services.

In my opinion, the government should pay for the professional staff, because these places are very important for the community, especially for the poor families and the old people. However, the volunteers can also help the staff in some activities like the events or the cleaning of the park.

In conclusion, both views have good points, but I believe the local government should take the main responsibility for these services.
title: Volunteers running local services
